message.zh: Tibi 0.1.5 已发布：全站视觉质感与插图图标升级——新增定制 Tibi 双色调图标与多场景藏狐插图，重构阅读器总结面板（CEFR 难度标尺、丝绒柔光摘要与建议卡、开放式短语索引），优化浅色与深色模式层次。
message.en: Tibi 0.1.5 is out: refreshed visual craft with custom Tibi duotone icons, expanded mascot illustrations across empty and hero states, a redesigned Reader summary panel (CEFR scale, silk-tinted overview & advice cards, clean phrase index), and calmer borderless hierarchy in light & dark mode.
